subject: Evidence & Conditional Approval — bridge plan for MAP and signature dependencies
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@cardinalhealth.com>, procurement <procurement@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Evidence & Conditional Approval — bridge plan for MAP and signature dependencies

Hi Marta / Procurement team,

Attached is our draft Mutual Action Plan (MAP) and an evidence checklist that maps to the acceptance gates we discussed on the call. High-level ask: can Cardinal confirm which of these evidence items are sufficient for a conditional MSA signature (i.e., sign MSA now with order form to follow after pilot acceptance)? We want to avoid a hard stop at legal if the procurement team can accept a conditional signature approach.

Attachments: redwood_MAP_draft_20260908.pdf (MAP draft), cardinal_evidence_checklist_v1.xlsx (acceptance matrix)

Quick questions to help us align the MAP:
- Which security artifacts are mandatory up-front (SOC2, encryption attestations, SSO telemetry)?
- Is a redline DPA required before you can sign an MSA, or can you accept DPA redlines to be finalized during the pilot?
- Does procurement need escrow/third-party attestation language in place prior to signature?

Our proposed flow (open to tweaks):
1) Sign MSA with limited/data-scope language + placeholder DPA reference (conditional signature).
2) Start pilot / eval against acceptance criteria in the MAP.
3) Execute order form once acceptance gates are met and final DPA is agreed.

If helpful, Jordan can provide the SOC2 redacted link and our SSO diagram today. Happy to hop on a 20–30 minute sync to walk through the checklist.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Sr. Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0134

From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@cardinalhealth.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@cardinalhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence & Conditional Approval — bridge plan for MAP and signature dependencies

Vanessa — thanks for the materials. A few immediate items from procurement/legal we need clarified before we can commit to a conditional signature:

1) SOC2 Type II: we need either the full report (redacted) or a SOC2 letter from your auditor. When can you provide that?
2) DPA redlines: Legal typically requires the DPA to be substantially agreed before MSA signature. Can you accept a clause that ties order form activation to final DPA?
3) Data scope in the order form: we prefer a narrow, pilot-only data scope for the initial order form. Will you put pilot-specific terms in the order form?
4) Escrow / vendor attestation: do you offer an escrow/attestation option, or would Redwood accept a limited indemnity with remediation SLAs?

If we can get SOC2 and SSO/SAML proof by EOD tomorrow and a DPA redline by Thursday, procurement can target an internal approval window for signature the week of 9/14.

Thanks — cc'd procurement so they see the timeline constraints.

Regards,
Marta Alvarez
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement | Cardinal Health
marta.alvarez@cardinalhealth.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>
To: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@cardinalhealth.com>, procurement <procurement@cardinalhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Sep 2026 14:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evidence & Conditional Approval — bridge plan for MAP and signature dependencies

Hi Marta — thanks for the clear list. See inline responses and a proposed gating checklist below.

On Tue, Sep 8, 2026 at 11:05 AM Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@cardinalhealth.com> wrote:
> Vanessa — thanks for the materials. A few immediate items from procurement/legal we need clarified before we can commit to a conditional signature:
>
> 1) SOC2 Type II: we need either the full report (redacted) or a SOC2 letter from your auditor. When can you provide that?

We can provide a redacted SOC2 Type II report via a secure link by EOD tomorrow. If you prefer, we can also provide an independent attestation letter from our auditor — will confirm by noon tomorrow.

> 2) DPA redlines: Legal typically requires the DPA to be substantially agreed before MSA signature. Can you accept a clause that ties order form activation to final DPA?

Yes — Redwood is open to an MSA that references a DPA to be finalized during the pilot, with a clause that conditions order form activation on final DPA execution. Draft wording attached in the MAP under "conditional activation".

> 3) Data scope in the order form: we prefer a narrow, pilot-only data scope for the initial order form. Will you put pilot-specific terms in the order form?

We will. Proposed order form will explicitly limit processing to pilot data and the evaluation workload. Full production terms will be in subsequent order form(s).

> 4) Escrow / vendor attestation: do you offer an escrow/attestation option, or would Redwood accept a limited indemnity with remediation SLAs?

We do not currently offer traditional source-code escrow for hosted SaaS, but we can provide:
- a signed vendor attestation + SOC2 link,
- a documented remediation SLA (we propose 72-hour critical remediation), and
- we are open to a short-term contract fallback (e.g., 30-day termination cure) if specific data protections are not met.

Proposed gating checklist (for order form activation):
- Security: Redacted SOC2 Type II or auditor letter (link provided).
- Access: SSO/SAML proof + network allowlist instructions executed.
- Pilot acceptance: 3 pilot acceptance criteria (functional smoke tests; latency/throughput baseline; data integrity check).
- DPA: Final redline agreed or explicit signoff from Cardinal Legal that order form activation can be conditioned on DPA finalization.

Attached: docusign_proposal_v2.pdf (placeholder with conditional activation language). HubSpot: DEAL-4729. Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCdef-MAP

If that aligns, Vanessa and I will prepare the MSA with the conditional activation clause and circulate a highlighted DPA for Legal review.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0246

From: Marta Alvarez <marta.alvarez@cardinalhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Evidence & Conditional Approval — bridge plan for MAP and signature dependencies

Jordan / Vanessa — appreciate the quick turnaround and the checklist. A few clarifications before we move to internal approval: 

- Pilot acceptance criteria (please confirm exact test cases):
  1) Functional: end-to-end inference for 3 sample flows provided by Cardinal (pass/fail).
  2) Performance: 95th-percentile latency < 600ms for the sample workload during pilot window.
  3) Data handling: no PII persisted beyond pilot; automatic purge verified.

- DPA: Legal would like to review your DPA redline as a tracked PDF. Can you deliver that by Thursday EOD?
- SOC2: procurement needs the redacted report or the auditor letter by tomorrow EOD to keep our internal target.

If we get those items on the timetable above, procurement can present for signature the week of 9/14. Otherwise, signature slips to the week after.

Thanks — will await the redacted SOC2 link and the DPA redline.

Best regards,
Marta Alvarez
Sr. Manager, Strategic Procurement | Cardinal Health
